title: Debrief sample exercise, 15 Jun 2023
description: Unclassified sample data for demonstrations, walkthroughs and blog posts (DEP-08). Real open AIS traffic east of the entrance to Chesapeake Bay, with an invented exercise on top: a blue ownship, a red submarine, the ownship's sonar bearings and a scripted narrative, over three serials. Every plot here is unclassified (SEC-02).
